records.pz: 小口短颈、丰肩敛腹的梅瓶，是元代青花最具代表性的器型之一。腹部满绘缠枝牡丹，花瓣层叠、枝叶连环，钴料浓处见铁锈斑——这是进口苏麻离青的典型呈色。
records.pe: The meiping — small mouth, broad shoulders, tapering body — is among the most characteristic Yuan blue-and-white shapes. Its belly carries a dense scroll of peonies; the rust-brown flecks in the deepest cobalt mark the imported Sumali (smalt) blue.

records.tz: 青花萧何月下追韩信图梅瓶
records.te: Meiping with Xiao He pursuing Han Xin by moonlight
records.pz: 大维德基金会藏两件至正十一年（1351）款青花瓶之一。腹部主纹以历史人物故事入画，衬松石芭蕉。釉下纪年铭文为元青花提供了无可辩驳的断代依据。
records.pe: One of the Percival David Collection vases dated by underglaze inscription to 1351. Narrative figure painting on the belly, set against rock and plantain — and a dated inscription that anchors all Yuan blue-and-white chronology.

records.pz: 口沿外撇、厚胎合手，故名"压手杯"。杯身缠枝莲八朵，双狮滚绣球纹。永乐御窑以苏麻离青浓艳呈色著称，是明代官窑青花的第一个高峰。
records.pe: A heavy-rimmed cup that fits the hand — hence "bowl-hand cup". Eight lotus scrolls and lions playing with a brocade ball. Yongle imperial wares mark the first peak of Ming official-kiln blue-and-white.

records.tz: 青花海水白龙纹高足碗
records.te: Stem bowl with white dragons among waves
records.pz: 外壁绘五爪白龙腾跃于海水江崖之间，龙纹矫健、青花浓艳。高足中空，圈足内书青花楷书年款——宣德款识成为后世官窑书款的范式。
records.pe: Five-clawed white dragons leaping through waves and cliffs. The hollow stem and the blue-and-white reign mark inside the foot set the template for official-kiln marks thereafter.

records.pz: 盘心开光绘花卉石雀，边壁分格绘折枝花卉与杂宝——把器面切分为独立装饰空间的"开光"构图，正是克拉克瓷的标志。它因葡萄牙克拉克大帆船（carrack）得名，十六世纪末风靡欧洲。
records.pe: A central medallion of flowers and birds, with panelled borders dividing the rim into discrete decorative fields — the panelling that defines kraak. Named for the Portuguese carracks that carried it, kraak conquered Europe in the late sixteenth century.

records.pz: 塔形腹、细长流，腹部满绘璎珞纹与莲瓣纹。康熙青花使用云南珠明料，发色翠艳、层次分明，号称"翠毛蓝"，是清代青花的最高水准。
records.pe: A tower-shaped body with a slender spout, covered in garland and lotus-petal bands. Kangxi cobalt from Yunnan yielded the celebrated "kingfisher blue" — the finest blue of the Qing.

records.pz: 日本有田窑仿景德镇青花而成，发展出釉下青花加釉上红金彩的"伊万里"。纹样仍是中国的牡丹与凤凰，配色却是日本的金碧富贵——纹样被继承，审美被重写。
records.pe: Arita ware imitated Jingdezhen blue-and-white, then invented Imari: underglaze blue heightened with overglaze red and gold. The motifs remain Chinese peonies and phoenixes; the aesthetic is emphatically Japanese.

records.tz: 代尔夫特锡釉青花陶盘
records.pz: 荷兰代尔夫特以锡釉陶（faience）而非瓷土仿制青花，钴蓝柔和、略带灰调。盘心绘中国风亭台楼阁与花鸟——那是荷兰画工从未到过的中国，一座想象中的亭台。
records.pe: Delft imitated blue-and-white in tin-glazed earthenware rather than porcelain. Its softer, greyer cobalt frames Chinese pavilions and birds: a China imagined by Dutch painters who had never been there.

records.tz: 韦奇伍德碧玉细炻瓷浮雕章
records.pz: 英国韦奇伍德以碧玉细炻瓷做出深邃的蓝底白浮雕。青花在这里退出了"画在器物上的纹样"，变成"器物本身的颜色"——从表面装饰到材料本体的转译，是这次旅行最远的一站。
records.pe: Wedgwood turned the blue of qinghua into the body itself: jasperware, a deep blue stoneware carrying white classical reliefs. Blue ceased to be decoration on a vessel and became the material of the vessel.

records.tz: 长沙窑青釉褐绿彩诗文壶
records.pz: 青花出现之前，唐代长沙窑已用褐绿彩在青釉上书写诗文与绘画。它是九世纪印度洋贸易中中国陶瓷的主力，也是"以文字与图像装饰瓷器"这一传统更早的源头。
records.pe: Before blue-and-white, Tang-dynasty Changsha kilns painted verses and pictures in iron-brown and green over a celadon glaze. The mainstay of ninth-century Indian Ocean trade — and an earlier origin of the inscribed vessel.
